research_unlock_fertilizer_blurb: Unlocks Synthetic fertilizer in the general store. Instant, bought by the bag, and it ends organic.
research_unlock_tomato_blurb: Unlocks Tomato seeds in the general store.
research_unlock_grape_blurb: Unlocks Grape seeds in the general store.
research_unlock_raspberry_blurb: Unlocks Raspberry seeds in the general store. Sells high and rots fast.
research_unlock_crop_variants_blurb: Happy plants can ripen as a better grade. Shop packs stay Common until you learn Trusted seed bank.
research_unlock_heirloom_blurb: Unlocks Őstermelő. Heirloom produce can sell for more.
research_unlock_expand_blurb: Unlocks land expansion on the map edge, and grants the first expansion permit.
research_unlock_pickaxe_blurb: Unlocks Pickaxe and Hardened pickaxe in the general store.
research_expand_land_blurb: A second expansion permit. Land still costs money on top of the permit.
research_eminent_domain_blurb: A third expansion permit. Further permits are contract work, not paperwork.
research_unlock_landscaping_blurb: Unlocks Grass seeds, Wooden fence and every paving tile in the general store.
research_unlock_irrigation_blurb: Unlocks Pipe and Tap in the general store. Route the water the farm pump already lifts.
research_unlock_water_storage_blurb: Unlocks Well and Pumpjack in the general store. A second source, for when one pump runs short.
research_unlock_auto_irrigation_blurb: Unlocks Sprinkler and Manual valve in the general store.
research_unlock_adv_irrigation_blurb: Unlocks Vertical sprinkler and Large sprinkler in the general store.
research_unlock_sensors_blurb: Unlocks the Sensors shelf: lever, button, lamp, pulser, counter, and field readers.
research_unlock_advanced_sensors_blurb: Unlocks AND, OR, and NOT. AND is on if both inputs are. OR if either is. NOT inverts.
research_unlock_smart_irrigation_blurb: Every sprinkler gains a crop dial and a signal input. Unlocks Smart valve.
research_unlock_vehicles_blurb: Unlocks Hangar. Buy Quads, tractors and trailers at a hangar.
research_unlock_dispatch_blurb: Vehicles follow a shared stop list; the traffic light holds a vehicle only if that light is a stop.
research_unlock_silos_blurb: Unlocks Seed, Spray and Produce silo in the general store. Stock the field, not the house.
research_unlock_contracts_blurb: The stall can take orders from buyers.
research_unlock_better_tools_blurb: Unlocks Better shovel and Large bucket in the general store.
research_unlock_chest_blurb: Unlocks Chest in the general store.
research_unlock_grinder_blurb: Unlocks Seed grinder and Mill in the general store.
research_unlock_preservatives_blurb: Unlocks Jam machine, Freezer, and Sugar in the general store.
research_unlock_fermentation_blurb: Unlocks Sugar cane seeds, Pot still, and Barrel. Ripe cane is fruit. Mill cane for sugar.
research_grant_silo_rows: Uncommon and Rare rows in the seed silo
research_grant_heirloom_column: Heirloom rarity column in the store
research_grant_land_edge: Land expansion on the map edge
research_grant_hangar_stock: Quad, tractor and trailer at the hangar
